games.title: Sword Shrine Guardian
games.description: A moody isometric 3D action game built with three.js. Take up a spirit blade at a mist-shrouded shrine: read enemy telegraphs, parry to open execution windows, dodge unblockable slams, unleash flying sword qi and a blade rain storm, and break the stone guardian's posture across a two-phase boss fight. Random night events — blood moons, living sword spirits, treasure guests — rewrite each wave's rules, so no two nights play alike. Forge your build wave by wave, then hold the shrine forever in endless mode and chase your best-wave record.
games.controls: WASD to move. J or left-click to attack (3-hit combo, third hit is heavy). K or right-click to parry — a successful parry opens an execution window; press attack to execute. Space to dodge with invincibility frames. L: flying sword qi. U: blade rain AoE. After each wave pick 1 of 3 upgrades (click or press 1/2/3). Watch for random night events each wave. Clear the boss to unlock endless mode. Touch controls supported on mobile.

10 waves of enemies with increasing difficulty
